readOnly.description: The server shows its home and changes nothing: calls that would change it fail ReadOnlyServer.

cwd.description: The directory the conversation works in.

id.description: The id to name it by, chosen by the client; not all digits. Starting with an id that names a conversation, a chosen one or its number, answers with that one by the id other calls name it by, and changes nothing.

provider.description: Absent for the default: the project's default_model, the home's, the model chosen last, else the preferred provider.

model.description: Without a provider, it goes to the default model's provider.

instructions.description: Instructions the model follows in this conversation, beside its own. Its subagents don't get them.

conversation.description: A conversation's id: the one its client chose at conversation/start, or else the number it gave.

model.description: Absent for the provider's own choice, as Claude Code makes it.

effort.description: Absent for the model's own default.

model.description: The model it runs, defaults applied, with the provider's default model when none was named; for an id that names one, that conversation's.

id.description: A conversation's id: the one its client chose at conversation/start, or else the number it gave.

number.description: The kernel's number for it, by which a view's parent and the task graph name it; the same as id when its client chose none.

title.description: What a person knows it by: a subagent's title, or else the first line of its first prompt. Absent before its first prompt.

of.description: A conversation's id: the one its client chose at conversation/start, or else the number it gave.

fork.description: The conversation it was forked from.

model.description: Absent for the provider's own choice, as Claude Code makes it.

effort.description: Absent for the model's own default.

approvals.description: `ask`: calls that change things wait for approval/resolve; `auto`: every call runs without asking.

parent.description: A conversation's id: the one its client chose at conversation/start, or else the number it gave.

root.description: The conversation people started, at the top of the tree.

call.description: The parent's call that started it.

task.description: Its task name, such as /root/explore, which agents address it by. Absent when its parent's provider runs it, as Claude Code runs its own subagents: then it takes input only through its parent, and stops when its parent's run does.

lineage.description: Where a subagent comes from. It runs on its parent's provider, in its directory.

instructions.description: What the client that started it asked the model to follow, beside its own.

message.description: Why the run ended without an answer.

said.description: The last message the model wrote in the conversation.

ended.description: How the conversation's last run ended.

result.description: Every conversation, subagents included, oldest first.

conversation.description: A conversation's id: the one its client chose at conversation/start, or else the number it gave.

requestId.description: Submitting again with the same id is answered once. The input's sigma.user entry keeps it in its data, or its sigma.withdrawn entry when it is withdrawn before it runs.

author.description: Who wrote it; the input is placed as a sigma.user entry naming them, and waits in pi.inbox with them.

name.description: What the transcript calls it, such as its file name.

mimeType.description: image/png, image/jpeg, image/gif, image/webp or image/bmp.

images.description: Placed after the text, each prepared to fit the model's image limits (resized or converted); the entry's data names them.

steer.description: Reach the run in flight at its next step instead of waiting for it to end; idle, it starts a run.

conversation.description: A conversation's id: the one its client chose at conversation/start, or else the number it gave.

from.description: Start the window at this entry, such as the one after the last you hold.

min.description: The newest entries the window holds at least; 50.

max.description: Past this many, the oldest leave the window down to min; twice min.

parent.description: The conversation this one was forked from, and the last entry it inherits.

owner.description: The task that created this conversation, and that task's conversation.

kind.description: pi.user, pi.assistant and pi.tool-result carry model messages in `model`; sigma.run_end says how a run ended in `data`, sigma.approval who answered a call, sigma.withdrawn which input was withdrawn before it ran.

entries.description: A window over the transcript, oldest first.

before.description: The entry just before the window; absent when the window starts the transcript.

docs.description: pi.agent, pi.live, pi.inbox, pi.provider, pi.usage and sigma.approvals, by kind; pi.live holds the run in flight, sigma.approvals the calls waiting for a person.

ops.description: The operations one commit applied to the view, in order: ["r", value] replaces it, ["s", path, value] sets, ["d", path] deletes, ["a", path, text] appends text, ["t", path, length] truncates text, ["p", path, at, deleteCount, items] splices an array, ["m", path, permutation] reorders one.

result.description: The view through the window, then each commit's changes to it.

conversation.description: A conversation's id: the one its client chose at conversation/start, or else the number it gave.

limit.description: The most entries one page holds.

at.description: Cut the context off after this entry; absent for the context now.

author.description: Who asked; the `/compact` input of a provider that compacts in a run names them.

instructions.description: What the summary should keep, beside what it always keeps.

outcome.description: compacted: its pi.compaction entry is placed, at once or, behind a run in flight, at the run's next step or after it. nothing_to_compact: there was not enough context to summarize. stopped: interrupted or withdrawn before it ended.

maxTurns.description: The tool rounds one run may take before it ends failed, naming the limit; null for no limit, the default.

additionalProperties.description: Tokens spent, as the providers reported them.

tools.description: By tool name: what tools that call models spent, such as a summary a tool asked for.

accepted.description: False when another answer came first, or the call is no longer waiting: the first answer counts.

result.description: Every extension in the home, in the order they load.
Loads every extension again from disk, with its options from config.toml, then swaps them in, clears every status line and unloads the old ones.

seq.description: The last commit this server published before the watch began; 0 when it has published none since it started. Every later item has a greater seq.

conversation.description: A conversation people started; its tree is it and its subagents.

ended.description: The run of the conversation itself ended at seq.
